target: acceptance 6 — spec 009's `## Attempt ledger` bullets are subject to the same merging and cap. One discipline for the file, not two.
cmd: cp "$FIXTURES/learnings/with_ledger.md" t.md; "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/learnings.sh" consolidate t.md >/dev/null 2>&1; dup=$(grep -c "tried regex widening" t.md); other=$(grep -c "tried a flat schema" t.md); lesson=$(grep -c alpha t.md); head=$(grep -c "## Attempt ledger" t.md); printf '{"ledgerDupMerged":%s,"ledgerOtherKept":%s,"lessonKept":%s,"headingKept":%s}' "$dup" "$other" "$lesson" "$head"
